title: Printed 500 ml bottle
assessment_instructions: Prioritize visible lid design and readable capacity markings. Do not infer thermal insulation or leak resistance from appearance.

fields.name: lid_design
fields.description: Visible lid mechanism; null if unclear.

fields.name: printed_capacity_ml
fields.description: Capacity printed visibly in ml; never infer from size.

fields.name: height_width_ratio
fields.description: Approximate visible bottle height divided by width.

fields.name: visible_text
fields.description: Exact readable text on the bottle.

fields.name: mouth_visible
fields.description: Actual drinking opening is visibly exposed.
